Clicking a commit in the diff pane's Commits tab expands it again, even when the commit carries a huge minified bundle.

- A commit whose diff, together with the Branch tab's, went over the engine's 4 MiB state limit did nothing when clicked; the pane now keeps diffs within that limit
- Files with very long lines (minified builds) or very large diffs show their +/− counts and "Too large to show" instead of their content

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
